verdicts.reason: A: clean left-to-right banner with the quote on a tidy 3-line stack and the product centred in its circle, but the SOLSTICE logo floats alone in the middle gap with no alignment to anything, and the attribution is almost as loud as the quote. B: the 2-line quote reads well, but the logo is jammed beside the attribution and against the product circle, and the product is shrunk and pushed to the top of its circle so its label is illegible. That makes the right side look cramped and arbitrary.
